test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is '**under**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses how blood is pushed out of the heart and into the arteries.
 
• The appropriate preposition should describe the condition of the blood within the arteries.
 
• "**Under**" fits well as it describes the state of the blood being pushed with high pressure.
 
• Other options ("**in**", "**from**", "**of**") do not fit the context of describing the pressure condition.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

 

Complete Passage: *One of the **most **efficient systems of the human body is the circulatory system. It is considered to be made up of complex and delicate blood vessels which **carry **blood to and from the heart. This system comprises arteries, veins and capillaries. The blood is pushed out of the heart to arteries **under **__high pressure. (4) ........, the arteries have thick and muscular veins. Veins bring blood from all parts of the body and work as the purifying (5) ........ in the system. Capillaries transfer blood from arteries to veins.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• In : "In" is used to indicate location or position within specific limits, which does not fit the context of describing pressure.
 
• From : "From" is used to indicate a starting point or origin, which is not suitable for describing pressure conditions.
 
• Of : "Of" is used to indicate possession or association, which does not effectively describe the state of pressure.
